* ⚠️Remove support for value `charge_refunded` from enum `Dispute.status`
  * This value was not fully operational.

currentOfficialAPI.statusPreventedMeaning: A dispute that was prevented from becoming a formal chargeback.
currentOfficialAPI.scope: Confirms documented status/closure description; does not independently prove that all prevention modes refund money.

supportContext.scope: Automatic refund conditions during dispute prevention, context only; not a complete per-status funds contract.

limitations: Generated type membership is independently checked. Treating prevented as lost follows the existing RETURNED policy of plan-refund-rules; refund settlement for every prevention mode is not independently proven here. Legacy charge_refunded was removed as not fully operational; no live response is claimed.
